# Battle of Jalalabad

Battle of Jalalabad may refer to these battles at Jalalabad, Afghanistan:
*Battle of Jalalabad (1842), a conflict in the First Anglo-Afghan War
*Battle of Jalalabad (1989), a conflict in the 1989–1992 Afghan Civil War
See also
* Jalalabad (disambiguation)
* Siege of Jalalabad (1710), a conflict in the Mughal-Sikh Wars at Jalalabad, Shamli in India
